subject: Azure Marketplace private listing — metering exception & PSA addendum
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace private listing — metering exception & PSA addendum

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Attached is Redwood's term sheet (v3) for the private plan + a short PS addendum template we use when customers want us to perform onboarding work (metering integration, billing mapping, test harness). A few items we want to surface upfront so procurement can triage: 

- Metering: you mentioned a custom metering dimension the marketplace team requires (customer_subs_id). We included a proposed integration approach in the Marketplace_Metering_Specs.xlsx.
- Invoicing: ClearSky asked for Net45 settlement. Our standard is Net30; billing has downstream payout implications for Azure merchant onboarding.
- PSA (professional services): Redlines are typical but we can scope SOW milestones and tie payments to acceptance.
- Compliance: we'll include SOC2 attestation and a data deletion clause for PS deliverables.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Friday so we can get legal and finance aligned? 
1) Confirm the metering dimension is required and the team who owns it (engineering or platform).
2) Whether Net45 is a hard requirement or flexibility exists for early-payment or milestone splits.
3) Any internal PO/POC numbers we should include in the term sheet.

If helpful, suggest a 30-minute call Thursday afternoon to walk the Azure onboarding checklist and metering mapping.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior BD Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments:
- Redwood_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf
- Marketplace_Metering_Specs.xlsx
From: Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private listing — metering exception & PSA addendum

Ben —

Appreciate the doc. Quick answers from procurement/engineering: 

- Metering dimension (customer_subs_id) is required by our finance team for our internal billing centric reports. It will be owned by our platform team (cc'd Asha).
- Net45 is preferred; we have corporate policy for vendor payments that targets Net45 for non-SaaS line items. We can consider early-payment discounts but need Redwood to accept Net45 on the merchant settlement side.
- PO: we'll issue PO CSK-2026-1107 once terms are agreed.

Two asks from our side: 
1) We need a PSA addendum to capture the scope/acceptance criteria for the metering work and to include an audit right for our finance team during the first 90 days.
2) On indemnity and revenue recognition: our legal team flagged that if Redwood delays merchant onboarding >30 days, ClearSky incurs lost-revenue risk. We want a narrow SLA plus a short credit schedule (not a full refund).

Can Irene propose language for Net45 acceptance and the credit schedule? We can set a short call Thursday to align.

Thanks,
Michael Ortiz
Director, Finance Ops — ClearSky Health
michael.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Azure Marketplace private listing — metering exception & PSA addendum

Ben —

Reviewing ClearSky's asks. High level position from legal/finance: 

- Net45: acceptable with commercial mitigant. We will allow Net45 for the Azure merchant onboarding invoices provided we add a 1.5% early-payment incentive (Net30 equivalent discount) OR a small service fee (0.5%) applied to Net45 settlements to offset financing impact. Prefer the early-payment discount where possible.

- Credit schedule for onboarding delay: we can accept a limited SLA credit (capped to 10% of first-month estimated invoice) if Redwood misses agreed onboarding milestones attributable to Redwood's deliverables. Draft language: Redwood will provide milestone schedule; if Redwood misses milestone by >14 days without mutually agreed extension, ClearSky may claim a credit equal to 5% per missed milestone, up to 10% aggregate.

- PSA addendum: attached my redline (ClearSky_PS_Addendum_Redline.docx). Key asks included: 90-day audit right for metering mapping; explicit data deletion and handover clause for PS deliverables; IP remains with Redwood but client-specific mapping artifacts are licensed to ClearSky for internal billing only.

- Metering integration: engineering note: we can implement an optional customer_subs_id dimension; implementation will require a small onboarding project (2-3 dev days + test harness). Recommend the SOW estimate and milestone-based payment.

Next steps: I suggest we send this redline to ClearSky and propose the Net45 + 1.5% early-pay discount (or 0.5% fee) compromise. If they insist on Net45 without mitigant we push for a maximum 60-day acceptance and require finance approval.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachments:
- ClearSky_PS_Addendum_Redline.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private listing — metering exception & PSA addendum

Michael —

Thanks for the clarity and helpful framing. Quick proposal that blends both teams' constraints: 

Proposal (for your procurement review):
- Payment: Net45 accepted. Redwood will provide a 1.5% early-payment discount if ClearSky pays by Net30; alternatively Redwood will apply a 0.5% Net45 financing fee. Please indicate which you prefer on the PO.
- Onboarding SLA/credit: Redwood to commit to milestone schedule in SOW. For any milestone missed by >14 calendar days attributable to Redwood, ClearSky may claim 5% credit per milestone, up to 10% of first-month estimated Merchant invoice.
- Metering: Redwood will implement the customer_subs_id dimension. Work estimate: 3 dev days + QA + marketplace test harness. We'll include that as a PS line item in the SOW and tie final acceptance to marketplace test report.
- Audit / Data deletion: Redwood agrees to a 90-day audit window limited to metering mapping verification and will include a data deletion handover step post acceptance.

If that looks good I can: 
1) Upload a term sheet with these bullets into DocuSign for signature (link below).
2) Draft an SOW (3-4 pages) with the milestone schedule and acceptance criteria and circulate next week.

DocuSign term sheet: https://www.docusign.net/CLSK-RDW/Envelope/ZZ123456789
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/CLSK-67890

Would you like us to show the early-pay discount on the PO or just include language in the term sheet and invoice lines?

Cheers,
Ben
Senior BD Manager — Redwood Inference
